sources.locator: Bill Carryover section: bills pending in House at first regular-session adjournment; House request and reintroduction procedure
March14,2026 official Senate floor-session article, concluding statement Senate adjourned Sine Die; retained HTML title/date metadata
Final Parlimentary Procedure section: default to Jefferson Manual, U.S. House Rules and practices; committee-report section distinguishes advisory reports

reviewer: root coordinator; direct primary-source text inspection
findings: The official March14,2026 Senate account directly records Senate sine-die adjournment. This replaces the prior secondary House-adjournment account as a source for the four 2026 Senate records.

Current published legislative-process carryover guidance expressly concerns bills pending in the House and first-to-second regular-session procedure; it is not applied as a blanket Senate no-carryover rule. No House request deadline is promoted as a historically verified deadline.

Published Senate rules govern uncovered cases by Jefferson Manual and U.S. House Rules/practices. This inspection did not establish the rule application needed to resolve each named pending Senate bill’s carryover/terminal effect. Absence of a matching carryover heading is not proof of prohibition.
limitations: Current published procedural guidance observed November9 does not independently establish its entire historical version history.
Adjournment is not an exhaustive bill-history or successor-law finding.
The separate SB857/SB583 comparison question remains open.
